text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the sparrows, we got rid of the bad guys, but... What should we do with a monster plant this big?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スズメさんのおかげで、
悪い人はやっつけられましたけど……
こんな大きな魔物植物、
どうしたらいいんでしょう！？

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Kyouka! My stomach's still full of bubbles, so it looks like it's slowing down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫です、
キョウカちゃん！
まだお腹の中が泡だらけなせいか、
動きが鈍そうですし。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: You're right, it still looks like it's in a bit of pain! Let's finish it off while we still can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
まだちょっと苦しそうです！
今のうちにやっつけてしまいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! It's a flower festival that I worked so hard to prepare, with everyone's help...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その意気です！
みんなに助けてもらいながら、
一生懸命準備した花祭りなんです……！

text_block_list.name: Suzume
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get in my way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対に、
邪魔はさせませんよ～！
